evals.name: tvalid-dropped-without-handshake
evals.expected_output: Report should flag CRITICAL H1 (TVALID dropped without handshake in state 2'd1) and CRITICAL R1 (TVALID not cleared in reset). Should provide corrected code for both. Should suggest SVA assertions.

assertions.description: Report must contain at least one CRITICAL finding
Must identify the TVALID stickiness rule violation
Fix must mention waiting for TREADY
Overall assessment must be FAIL

evals.name: tdata-width-not-byte-aligned
evals.expected_output: Flag CRITICAL W1 for 12-bit TDATA and recommend padding to 16 with two qualifier bits. Do not invent an independent W2 finding from a fractional byte count; reset and the shown holding behavior are correct.

assertions.description: Must identify TDATA width non-compliance
Fix must recommend 16-bit TDATA
Must NOT flag reset — TVALID is correctly cleared in reset
Must NOT flag handshake — TVALID handling is correct

evals.name: tvalid-gated-by-tready-combinatorial-loop
evals.expected_output: Report must flag CRITICAL C1/H2 — TVALID is combinatorially derived from TREADY (assign TVALID = data_ready & TREADY). This creates a potential combinatorial loop and violates H2. TDATA/TKEEP payload stability is at risk too since TDATA is updated from FIFO without checking stall. Should explain the combinatorial loop risk clearly.

assertions.description: Must be flagged as CRITICAL
Must identify the combinatorial dependency issue
Must explain the combinatorial loop risk
Overall assessment must be FAIL

evals.name: fully-compliant-master
evals.expected_output: This RTL is compliant. Report should give PASS or PASS WITH WARNINGS. Must NOT flag spurious CRITICAL issues. May give INFO notes (e.g., TDATA updates on same cycle as TREADY — payload stability in zero-latency back-to-back transfers). Should still provide SVA assertions.

assertions.description: Must not give a FAIL result for compliant code
Must give PASS or PASS WITH WARNINGS
Must still provide SVA assertions even for passing code

evals.name: legal-24-bit-sparse-stream
evals.prompt: Review only the width and qualifier legality of this AXI4-Stream fragment: output [23:0] TDATA; output [2:0] TKEEP; output [2:0] TSTRB; assign TKEEP=3'b101; assign TSTRB=3'b101; assign TLAST=1'b0;
evals.expected_output: 24-bit data, sparse mask, null lanes before TLAST, and constant-low TLAST are legal. Do not recommend filling null lanes. Handshake/reset remain unreviewed.

assertions.description: 24-bit data, sparse mask, null lanes before TLAST, and constant-low TLAST are legal. Do not recommend filling null lanes. Handshake/reset remain unreviewed.

evals.name: position-bytes-without-tkeep
evals.prompt: Review these AXI4-Stream qualifiers; TKEEP is omitted: output [31:0] TDATA; output [3:0] TSTRB; assign TSTRB=4'b0101;
evals.expected_output: Omitted TKEEP defaults to ones, and TSTRB zeros mark position bytes. No warning for the omission alone. Do not claim whole-interface PASS.

assertions.description: Omitted TKEEP defaults to ones, and TSTRB zeros mark position bytes. No warning for the omission alone. Do not claim whole-interface PASS.

evals.name: interleaved-streams
evals.prompt: On successive accepted AXI4-Stream beats, (TID,TDEST,TLAST) is (0,0,0), (1,0,1), (0,0,1). Payload and sidebands are held during stalls. Does this violate packet identity?
evals.expected_output: Legal interleaving of distinct streams; packet tracking is per TID/TDEST. Do not require waiting for TLAST before every ID change without an endpoint restriction.

assertions.description: Legal interleaving of distinct streams; packet tracking is per TID/TDEST. Do not require waiting for TLAST before every ID change without an endpoint restriction.

evals.name: ready-feedback-in-elastic-register
evals.prompt: Review the handshake update only: always_ff @(posedge ACLK) if (!ARESETn) TVALID <= 0; else if (!TVALID || TREADY) begin TVALID <= src_valid; TDATA <= src_data; end
evals.expected_output: READY feedback permits replacing a consumed beat; TVALID/payload hold on stalls. Do not flag H2/C1 merely because TREADY appears in registered enable logic. Upstream acceptance and omitted signals require separate review.

assertions.description: READY feedback permits replacing a consumed beat; TVALID/payload hold on stalls. Do not flag H2/C1 merely because TREADY appears in registered enable logic. Upstream acceptance and omitted signals require separate review.

evals.name: reserved-qualifier-combination
evals.prompt: Review this active Stream beat: TVALID=1, TKEEP=4'b0011, TSTRB=4'b0111.
evals.expected_output: Flag K3: lane 2 uses reserved TKEEP=0/TSTRB=1. Legal sparse masks do not legalize that combination.

assertions.description: Flag K3: lane 2 uses reserved TKEEP=0/TSTRB=1. Legal sparse masks do not legalize that combination.
